Sure! Here’s a quick step‑by‑step guide so you can get those burgers and chicken wings delivered right to your door: | Step | What to Do | |------|------------| | **1** | **Open the Uber EATS App (or website)** – If you don’t have the app yet, download it from Google Play / Apple Store or visit [ubereats.com](https://www.uber.com/eat). Log in or create an account if needed. | | **2** | **Search “McDonald’s”** – In the search bar type *“McDonald’s”* and hit enter. Make sure the location shown matches your delivery address. | | **3** | **Select the restaurant** – Tap on the McDonald’s listing that appears. You’ll see their menu. | | **4** | **Add Items to Cart**
• Find the burger section.
  - Add **5 Burgers** (you may need to choose specific types like Big Mac, Quarter Pounder, etc.).
• Go back to the main menu and find the Chicken Wings section.
  - Add **6 Chicken Wings** (usually available as a side or combo item). | | **5** | **Review Your Order** – Once all items are added, tap the cart icon. Double‑check quantities and prices. | | **6** | **Proceed to Checkout** – Click “Checkout.” Enter or confirm your delivery address, payment method, and any promo codes. | | **7** | **Place the Order** – Hit “Confirm & Pay.” You’ll receive a confirmation screen and later a tracking link showing when the driver picks up the food. | ### Tips: - **Timing:** Orders placed during peak hours (lunch/dinner) might take longer—consider ordering earlier if you’re hungry soon! - **Special Requests:** Use the “Notes” field before confirming to specify anything special (e.g., extra sauce, no onions). - **Track Delivery:** After placing the order, use the map view in the app to follow the courier’s progress. That’s it! Enjoy your meal. Let me know if you’d like help customizing the order or choosing sides.
